clue.text: Capital source of milk for doctor?

parts.note: MO is a medical officer, a doctor, and something for him is his, so MO'S
a cow is the animal that supplies milk

explanation.surface: A doctor wonders where his milk comes from.
explanation.walkthrough: Read the clue as 'the doctor's source of milk': MO'S COW. The question mark flags the playful possessive.
explanation.definitionFit: Moscow is the capital city of Russia.

clue.text: Discarded fish has to be thrown outside

indicators.note: the shuffled letters sit round the fish
thrown means upset or jumbled, so these letters are shuffled

parts.note: taken as written
sole is a flatfish

explanation.surface: A fish that was thrown away is to be tossed out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'thrown' rearranges TO BE as OBTE, which goes 'outside' SOLE.
explanation.definitionFit: Something obsolete is out of date and no longer used, so it has been set aside.

clue.text: Island state with military officer on top

parts.note: COL is the abbreviation for colonel
taken as written
to state is to say

explanation.surface: An island nation with an army colonel at its head.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down entry the first pieces sit on top of the last, hence 'on top'. Colonsay is a small island in the Inner Hebrides of Scotland.
explanation.definitionFit: Colonsay is a Hebridean island off Scotland's west coast.

clue.text: Unlike the small print, it's very obvious

definitions.meaning: text set in big letters, as opposed to fine print

explanation.surface: Unlike the fine print in a contract, this is plain to see.
explanation.definitionFit: Something displayed in big letters is clearly and unmistakably evident.

clue.text: No book-lover, but he's not common

parts.note: taken as written
leman is an old word for a sweetheart or lover

explanation.surface: A man who does not read, yet is still somehow refined.
explanation.walkthrough: 'book-lover' looks like one word for a reader, but splits into B (book) and LEMAN, an archaic word for a lover.
explanation.definitionFit: A peer of the realm is the opposite of a commoner, being of titled rank.

clue.text: Against being a candidate as yet

parts.note: against someone is not with them
to stand for election is to be a candidate, so standing

explanation.surface: Opposing someone who is not yet running for office.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Against' looks like the definition, but it splits as NOT WITH. 'as' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: As an adverb the answer means nevertheless, all the same.

clue.text: Appear to understand brief examination

parts.note: to look is to appear, as in to look tired
to see is to understand, as in I see

explanation.surface: Seeming to grasp something after a quick glance.
explanation.definitionFit: A look-see is an informal quick inspection.

clue.text: Feel nostalgic for our island state

parts.note: to miss something is to long for it
taken as written

explanation.surface: Homesick for an island home.
explanation.definitionFit: Missouri is a US state in the Midwest.

clue.text: He shows favouritism where set point is involved

indicators.note: involved means tangled or convoluted, so these letters are mixed up

explanation.surface: An umpire favours one player at set point in tennis.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who gives jobs to relatives is practising favouritism toward family.

clue.text: David shows MP is last resort

indicators.note: to re-sort is to sort again, so these letters are put into a new order

explanation.surface: A politician turns to the Bible's songwriter as a final hope.
explanation.walkthrough: 'last resort' reads as an idiom, but 'resort' is re-sort, the anagram signal acting on MP IS LAST.
explanation.definitionFit: King David is traditionally credited with writing the Psalms, so he is the archetypal hymn writer.

clue.text: Raise a bit of money before the match

definitions.text: a bit of money before the match

explanation.surface: Lifting a coin before kick-off.
explanation.walkthrough: Before a match a coin is flipped to decide who starts, and 'toss up' is also to throw something upward.
explanation.definitionFit: To throw upward is to lift into the air; the coin flip that opens a game is the other sense.

clue.text: Having left path. I will return to Welsh town

parts.note: a lane is a narrow path or road

indicators.note: to return is to come back, so these letters are read backwards

parts.note: contracted as I'LL

explanation.surface: Someone, having strayed from the route, promises to go back to a Welsh town.
explanation.walkthrough: 'return' turns I'LL into LLI, which closes the word.
explanation.definitionFit: Llanelli is a town in Carmarthenshire, south Wales.

clue.text: Guard required for prince's cortege

indicators.note: the letters needed are found running through the following words

explanation.surface: A royal funeral procession needs a protective detail.
explanation.definitionFit: An escort is someone who accompanies and protects, like a bodyguard.

clue.text: Display, we hear, horse or cow

indicators.note: says the preceding word is to be taken by its sound, not its spelling

parts.note: to air something is to show it off publicly
a shire is a large breed of English draught horse

explanation.surface: A livestock show asks whether an animal is a horse or a cow.
explanation.walkthrough: The Shire is a heavy English carthorse; Ayr is a Scottish town that sounds like 'air'.
explanation.definitionFit: An Ayrshire is a breed of dairy cattle from south-west Scotland.

clue.text: Current director puts one part of speech in order

indicators.note: says these pieces go inside the next one

parts.note: a rank is an order or row
I is the Roman numeral for one
a verb is one of the parts of speech

explanation.surface: A film director arranges words into grammatical order.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Current director' sounds like the boss now in charge, but it is what steers a river's current. 'puts' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: The ground along a stream's edge channels and guides the flowing water.

clue.text: Quails when the governor appears around five

definitions.note: plural noun; the answer is the collective noun for a group of these birds

indicators.note: the governor's title is wrapped round the next piece

parts.note: a bey was a provincial governor in the Ottoman Empire
V is the Roman numeral for five

explanation.surface: Someone trembles in fear as the governor turns up at five o'clock.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Quails' looks like a verb, to cower, but is the birds.
explanation.definitionFit: A bevy is the traditional collective term for a group of these game birds.

clue.text: Reserve card for service to readers

parts.note: to book is to reserve
a club is a playing card of the clubs suit

explanation.surface: Booking a card table for a reading group.
explanation.definitionFit: A reading circle or mail-order scheme supplies books to members.

clue.text: No citizen could be more unpleasant about convict

definitions.note: a citizen in the old sense is a town or city dweller, so this is one who is not

indicators.note: the first word goes round the second

parts.note: vile means unpleasant, so more unpleasant is viler
lag is British slang for a convict

explanation.surface: A citizen could hardly be nastier towards a prisoner.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Old lag' is British slang for a long-serving prisoner.
explanation.definitionFit: A country dweller lives in a small rural settlement rather than a city.

clue.text: Put one's foot in it? On the contrary, hand

indicators.note: says one piece goes inside another
reverses the order suggested, so the foot holds the other piece instead

parts.note: one is I, so one's is I'S

explanation.surface: After a gaffe, someone gets a punch.
explanation.walkthrough: The idiom suggests one's going round the foot; 'On the contrary' flips that, so the foot's abbreviation wraps the other piece.
explanation.definitionFit: A closed hand with fingers curled tightly is a fist.

clue.text: Take part in pilot activity to test public opinion

definitions.meaning: literally, to send a toy up on a string, piloting it
to float an idea to see how it is received

explanation.surface: A pilot scheme to sound out public opinion.
explanation.definitionFit: Floating a trial idea to gauge reaction is the figurative sense; the literal one is flying a toy.

clue.text: Diagnose incorrectly in US city

indicators.note: something done incorrectly is done wrong, so the letters go astray into a new order

explanation.surface: A doctor makes a misdiagnosis in an American city.
explanation.definitionFit: San Diego is a city in southern California.

clue.text: Celebration of life as TV broadcast

indicators.note: broadcast also means scattered widely, so the letters are scattered and reassembled

explanation.surface: A TV show celebrates life itself.
explanation.definitionFit: A festival is a period of public celebration or merrymaking.

clue.text: Old kings speaking for island group

indicators.note: says the word for the old kings is to be heard spoken, not seen

parts.note: pharaohs were the kings of ancient Egypt

explanation.surface: Ancient rulers speak on behalf of some islands.
explanation.walkthrough: Spelt Faroes or Faeroes, the islands lie between Shetland and Iceland.
explanation.definitionFit: The Faeroes are a North Atlantic archipelago belonging to Denmark.

clue.text: Exhausting task making king more poorly

parts.note: K is the chess abbreviation for king
ill means poorly, so more poorly is iller

explanation.surface: A tiring job makes the monarch feel even worse.
explanation.definitionFit: Informally, a gruelling job is called a real killer.

clue.text: Boys meeting in part of France

parts.note: Norm is a boy's name
Andy is another boy's name

explanation.surface: Two lads meet up in a French region.
explanation.definitionFit: Normandy is a region of northern France on the Channel coast.

clue.text: Get behind duck on body of water

parts.note: to lag is to fall behind
a duck in cricket is a score of nothing, O
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone trails behind a duck on a pond.
explanation.walkthrough: A duck is a nil score in cricket, hence O.
explanation.definitionFit: A lagoon is a stretch of salt water separated from the sea by a sandbank or reef.

clue.text: Pictures of mature insects

definitions.meaning: verb: forms a mental image of
the plural of imago, the adult winged form of an insect

explanation.surface: Photographs of adult bugs.
explanation.definitionFit: To picture is to visualise in the mind; adult insects in their final stage are imagoes.

clue.text: Flier's performance in air?

parts.note: a flier sounds like an aviator showing off, but here it is a feathered creature, and air is a tune, so the performance is its singing

explanation.surface: A pilot puts on an aerobatic display.
explanation.walkthrough: 'air' suggests the sky, but it is also a melody.
explanation.definitionFit: A bird's musical call is the singing heard from trees at dawn.

clue.text: Continue without a glance backwards

indicators.note: the phrase as a whole is read from its end to its start

parts.note: without means having no, so NO
a peek is a quick glance

explanation.surface: Carrying on without once looking back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'backwards' turns NO PEEK into one run read right to left.
explanation.definitionFit: To persist or go on doing something is to carry on.
